title: Top-Floor Mansion Flat, Kensington
summary: A light-filled top-floor apartment in a red-brick Victorian mansion block, with a vaulted reception room overlooking the plane trees.
description:
Placed on the top floor of a handsome red-brick mansion block, this two-bedroom apartment has been finished with an eye for detail throughout. The vaulted reception room is the heart of the home, with dormer windows framing the treetops, wide-plank oak floors and space for both a lounge and a dining table for six.

The kitchen is fitted with high-gloss cabinetry, marble worktops and integrated appliances. The principal bedroom looks out over the garden square, and the building benefits from a porter and a lift.

All details on this listing are placeholders for demonstration.
